notes.title: !AnyWay! - Lite
notes.content:
[h3]Launching the Lite Version[/h3]
Now all you need to do is select the "!AnyWay! - Lite" option when launching the game to start the Lite version.

[h3]Privacy[/h3]
You can now hide the interface by simply clicking on the eye icon.
[u][b]Additionally, we strongly recommend that you do not share your game key with anyone.[/b][/u] This is important to ensure the security of your account and prevent unauthorized access. Keep your key confidential and do not disclose it to third parties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32808238/12735742ce15d87747ea1f1730f985d3a128f0fd.png[/img]

[h3]Removing Other Versions of the Game[/h3]
If you prefer only the Lite version and want to remove other branches of the game, simply select the beta version "anyway_lite" in the Steam settings. This will free up space on your hard drive.




[i]Please note that the Lite version of !AnyWay! primarily focuses on reducing memory consumption and minimizing the need for frequent updates compared to the main branch of the game. The main version of the game is already well optimized and does not require significant CPU usage reduction.[/i]

notes.title: !AnyWay! - Reborn
notes.content:
The development team of the game !AnyWay! is excited to announce a major update that brings numerous new features and enhancements. The game has been completely rewritten from scratch, eliminating the tangled code and creating a more stable and optimized version. Regular updates are on the horizon, and we now present to you ANYWAY REBORN!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32808238/a049e70072308af1963b643ac74c0a6d02086999.png[/img]

[h3]The most significant change is the complete overhaul of the inventory system.[/h3]
The controls have become more intuitive, and items are organized into pages, allowing for easy navigation and retrieval of desired items. The new design and optimization ensure a smooth and seamless gameplay experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32808238/c6cc7c94dc2ebbadebc7f49ec9be1b95a476dcf1.png[/img]

[h3]The in-game store has undergone a complete revamp as well.[/h3]
With a new design and enhanced functionality, it is now more user-friendly and accessible. Players can easily explore and acquire various items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32808238/ce297ec5000adc361d4ed0c7ec7e6f904495bf6c.png[/img]

[h3]Music![/h3]
We are delighted to introduce a new playlist that allows you to enjoy the music obtained during events. The game not only becomes visually appealing but also lets you immerse yourself in the desired mood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32808238/b7a17b914277c02e3565542bc8899a77703ef878.png[/img]

[h3]New case opening system![/h3]
The updated case opening interface is now clearer and more intuitive. You can easily read the text and view details of the contents, making each opening more engaging and satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32808238/49f98400cda48f2572fa810c8cdec52c384938f1.png[/img]

The ticket crafting system has also undergone significant improvements. You can now immediately use 50 crafts (250 tickets), making the process more efficient.



The ANYWAY REBORN update not only enhances the quality of the gameplay but also reflects the feedback and preferences of our players. We strive to make the !AnyWay! game even better, and we look forward to seeing you in the world of the updated game.

The updated case opening interface is now clearer and more intuitive.
You can now immediately use 50 crafts (250 tickets), making the process more efficient.

notes.title: ANYWAY INVENTORY UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]New item drop system[/h1]

Now items are not directly given to you inventory. But that's okay!
You will receive 110 crystals every ~38 minutes, which can be exchanged for any available AniPack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32808238/f01440bb05a0650921f5ce60130d9ff30732f1f1.png[/img]

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]AniPack#1[/th]
        [th]AniPack#2[/th]
        [th]AniPack#5[/th]
        [th]Random AniPack[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32808238/ee2106bdf0e6652f7a553b8a12f98e4c21233b1c.png[/img][/td]

    [/tr]

All items will remain in the game inventory until you click withdraw item. After that, they will instantly going in your Steam inventory. 

Attention! Items that you have removed from the game inventory can no longer be returned back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32808238/1c63e80b06db7a6785afe910f6f33370b2eda908.png[/img]


[h2]Destroy items![/h2]

Any item can be destroyed and get crystals!
The amount of the reward received depends on the quality of the items. ːanywaybcː

Purple and red crystals are not used at the moment, save them!

[h2]Promo codes[/h2]

In the inventory menu, you can see the input field for promo codes. Find and use codes to get more crystals.

Please take part in the survey about v11.0 update [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe_fGGSfPWDE-EjgGZqNaR4CKgyqYZXyEKjEnPbPn0qKsV-SA/viewform?usp=sf_link]HERE[/url]
